title: Reserve Weekend Stroll | Rosemary Beach Vacation Rental With Gulf Views – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Relax and recharge at Weekend Stroll, a charming Rosemary Beach rental featuring stunning Gulf views. Perfect for a coastal getaway, just steps from the shore!
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at Barbery Coast with one set of beach chairs included (March 1 - October 31). Additional beach chairs available through Coastal Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Weekend Stroll is a beautifully appointed home offering an abundance of space, natural light, and stunning Gulf views. Every detail, both inside and out, has been thoughtfully curated to create the perfect blend of luxury and comfort. With three spacious levels, there's ample room and privacy for everyone. The home features a large family room, plus a bonus upstairs lounge with a wet bar for added entertainment options.

This well-equipped vacation retreat is designed to provide a truly relaxing and luxurious experience, with high-end amenities throughout, including a Sonos sound system, flat-screen TVs, curated art pieces for an upscale atmosphere, and a fully stocked gourmet kitchen with premium appliances. Luggage racks are thoughtfully placed in all walk-in closets for added convenience.

The second-floor main living area is designed for entertaining, with an open-concept layout that includes a spacious gourmet kitchen, a dining area for 11, and a comfortable living room. The kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances, and the dining table seats 8, with 3 additional seats at the breakfast bar. The living room is perfect for unwinding, with plush seating and easy access to a large deck featuring an outdoor fireplace and twin daybed swings.

For those seeking a more intimate entertaining space, the top floor boasts a bonus lounge with a wet bar. Step outside to enjoy the covered patios and balconies, or take a short walk to the Barberry Coast deeded beach access for the ultimate in beachside relaxation. Whether you're lounging at home or exploring the nearby shops and restaurants of Rosemary Beach, this home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and convenience.

Key Features:

Gulf views from 3rd Floor Balcony
Barbery Coast neighborhood in Inlet Beach
Deeded beach access just 2 minutes away
Community Pool, 60 feet from the house
Designer interiors and curated artwork
Multiple fireplaces (porch & balcony)
Patio with grill and outdoor shower
Dining for 8, plus breakfast bar for 3
Parking for 3 vehicles
Cable & WiFi
Washer & dryer
Open-concept living area with large flat-screen TV, Sonos system, and workspace
Gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances
4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and sleeps 10 (including bunk beds)

THIS PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7 NIGHT MINIMUM, SATURDAY TO SATURDAY, DURING SPRING BREAK & SUMMER.
